channel.title: European Medical Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from European Medical Journal (emjreviews.com)

item.title: FDA ends ‘two-trial dogma’ in historic shift
item.description: The FDA has announced that a single clinical trial will now be the default requirement for the approval of novel medicines. The post FDA ends ‘two-trial dogma’ in historic shift appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Pediatric Obstructive Sleep Apnea Raises Viral Infection Risk
item.description: Pediatric obstructive sleep apnea raised influenza and COVID-19 diagnoses over five years in a U.S. TriNetX large EHR cohort study. The post Pediatric Obstructive Sleep Apnea Raises Viral Infection Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: 3D Printing Reshapes Surgical Training
item.description: Fused Deposition Modelling 3D printing has become a practical, accessible, and cost-effective tool in surgical settings, a 2026 systematic review has found. The post 3D Printing Reshapes Surgical Training appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Mpox-HIV Coinfection Tied to Higher Hospitalization
item.description: Mpox-HIV coinfection in MSM was linked to more severe symptoms and higher hospitalization, in Hangzhou case series of 104 patients. The post Mpox-HIV Coinfection Tied to Higher Hospitalization appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: New Fingerstick Test Detects Hepatitis B Within One Hour
item.description: A new point-of-care fingerstick test detects HBV within one hour, a 2026 diagnostic accuracy study has found. The post New Fingerstick Test Detects Hepatitis B Within One Hour appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: WHO Clears Novel Oral Polio Vaccine for Global Use
item.description: WHO prequalification of an additional novel oral polio vaccine boosts global outbreak response, accelerating polio eradication efforts. The post WHO Clears Novel Oral Polio Vaccine for Global Use appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Genetic Obesity Risk Raises Breast Cancer Mortality
item.description: Breast cancer survivors with high genetic risk for excess body weight had 15% higher mortality, and required more weekly walking to mitigate inherited risk. The post Genetic Obesity Risk Raises Breast Cancer Mortality appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Meta Analysis Compares CAR T Constructs
item.description: Across 40 trials, 4 1BB based CAR T therapy targeting CD19 delivered the strongest remission rates and lower neurotoxicity in relapsed B cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukaemia. The post Meta Analysis Compares CAR T Constructs appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Silicone Gel Significantly Improves Head and Neck Scar Outcomes
item.description: A randomised placebo-controlled study shows silicone gel significantly improves scar quality in head and neck wounds without adverse effects. The post Silicone Gel Significantly Improves Head and Neck Scar Outcomes appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: AI Model Predicts Cardiac Tamponade During Ablation
item.description: Five key determinants of cardiac tamponade were highlighted: operator experience, D-dimer level, total heparin dose, AF type, and left atrial diameter. The post AI Model Predicts Cardiac Tamponade During Ablation appeared first on European Medical Journal.
